background_inspector.read_method: bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(load_ui=False,use_scripts=False) in separate factory/background processes; no save
background_inspector.initial_failure: library append via bpy.data.libraries.load crashed alpha build (139); subsequent direct background reads succeeded (0). No user process controlled or killed.

integrity.timestamp_note: Content pins use exact SHA-256 and byte lengths. Initial mtime_ns passed through JavaScript number serialization and lost sub-microsecond precision, so mtime equality is not claimed. After mtimes are exact decimal strings.

conclusion.source_reload_clip: verified absent; procedural rig relationships present
conclusion.w30_complete_moving_partition: not preserved: 14 Lever-only surface candidates plus 22 mixed fixed/lever cubes; partial lever is not complete
conclusion.recommendation: Preserve all 256 cubes, body detail and original texture; main-authored initial/loop/return body poses. Keep existing part candidates static; do not rotate the whole Frame/receiver.
conclusion.gate_hand_path_exit: Loading-gate semantics, exact hand-occluded insertion path and natural reload exit are unverified.

footage_context.provenance: User-provided W48 full-decode findings; video was not decoded in this parallel audit
footage_context.return_pose: main-authored, not verified as natural exit by this footage

rig_summary.status: verified rig; static saved pose, not unrigged
rig_summary.animation_verdict: No stored reload action/clip or keyframed animation. Two mechanical drivers are present; drivers are not a timed reload animation.
rig_summary.weights_verdict: All mesh vertices assigned to exactly one nonzero named group, weight 1.0; all triangles are wholly in one group.

lever_identity.constraint_caution: Rig capability only, not a footage measurement or a reload-motion prescription.

chamber_identity.loading_gate_identity: unknown; no Gate-named mesh or bone

rig_summary.magazine_identity: No separate named magazine mesh or bone. Integral Frame/tube storage surfaces are not semantically resolved; no detachable-magazine motion established.

shell_ammo_identity.units: two near-translation-equivalent 167-vertex cartridge-shaped units, one shared bone; not separate animated insert shells

blend.inspection_method: Separate background factory Blender process reads original with load_ui=False/use_scripts=False; autoexec disabled; no save or UI attachment.

drivers.expression: -.576 + trigger if trigger < 0.001 or slide == 0 else slide *2

blend.topology_caution: Disconnected mesh components include UV/material seams; explicit bone weights establish source part identity.

fbx.duplicate_caution: 17 geometry records include four identical Frame arrays, four identical Bullet arrays, four identical Sight arrays, four identical D9D3FB80 planes and one other four-vertex Sight plane. Totals count duplicates and degenerate triangles.
fbx.frame_discrepancy: 22846 raw FBX Frame triangles - 3854 exactly zero area = 18992 nonzero area, versus 18840 saved Blend triangles. Remaining 152-triangle difference unresolved; do not explain all differences as degenerates.

w30.coordinate_formula: model=(8+s*worldX,8+s*worldZ,8+s*worldY), s=17.675692296761287; no posed/evaluated mesh used (matches W30 builder).
builder_evidence: scripts/art/reconstruct_weapons_w30.py:61-150 reads unposed source meshes and merges source vertices/triangles
scripts/art/reconstruct_weapons_w30.py:187-226 greedily packs combined volume, losing source-part ownership
scripts/art/reconstruct_weapons_w30.py:286-290 assigns source_volume_### names and a flat outliner
scripts/build_weapons_w30.py: cube extents and face UVs copied in original order
w30.surface_mapping_method: Source rest-mesh triangle/cube AABB separating-axis intersection (box axes prefilter, triangle normal, 9 edge-cross-box axes), tolerance 1e-6 model units. Intersections at shared boundaries count in both cubes. Support counts are surface provenance, not rig bindings or percentage ownership.
w30.surface_mapping_caution: Support indicates source triangle intersection, not actual preserved rig binding or percentage ownership. Boundary contacts may touch multiple groups; exclusive support does not prove complete part isolation.
